mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift toward risk assets during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 1.5% over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative equity returns as corporate profit expectations decline due to reduced consumer spending capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) exceeding 5% from prior month indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative equity returns as housing sector contraction reduces aggregate consumption and corporate revenue growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 5% and RSAFS falls > 5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 110 indicates robust manufacturing output, driving positive equity returns through sustained corporate profit growth and reduced recession risk during expansionary economic cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A rising payroll employment trend (PAYEMS) above 152,000 thousand persons signals strengthening labor market conditions, generating positive equity returns through increased consumer spending and corporate earnings growth over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 152,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 260 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP (GDPC1) below 19,000 billion and housing starts (HOUST) below 1,500 thousand units signal broad-based economic weakness, causing negative equity returns through reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue forecasts.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 19000 and HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS below 2.0% during low interest rate regimes sustains accommodative monetary policy, generating positive equity returns through prolonged low discount rates and enhanced risk asset attractiveness over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0.
